name: hud_ui_mgr_objective_block_destructor
description: HudUiMgrObjectiveBlock::~HudUiMgrObjectiveBlock tears down the chat input, objective bar/meter tables, and objective widgets.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja shows the retail body includes compiler-generated EH frame state; the source relies on the recovered C++ destructor owner and compiler-generated member teardown.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40d660 destroys chatComposeTextInput, restores objectiveBar and objectiveMeter to g_HudUiCommon_FTable, then destroys objectiveSensorRect and objectiveWidget.
HudUiTextInput::DestructorCore and HudUiWidget::DestructorCore are already functionally equivalent dependencies.

The registered static-destructor native smoke verifies the embedded objective block through HudUiMgr teardown, including objective bar/meter common-table restoration and image release/table restoration for both objective widgets.
